about.title: ABOUT PEPENODE
about.desc: PEPENODE brings gamified meme coin mining to the masses. No physical computing power required. PEPENODE allows you to build a customized meme coin mining rig, in your own virtual server room. More nodes = More meme coins!

cards.title: Buy Nodes
cards.content: Without nodes, your server room is empty. Use $PEPENODE token to fill your server room with mining nodes. Nodes have unique properties. Combine certain nodes for increased mining power to earn more meme coins!

cards.title: Upgrade Facility
cards.content: The more nodes your server room has, the more mining power. Upgrading your virtual mining rig allows you to mine a larger amount of meme coins. PEPENODE is 100% virtual, and requires no additional computing power.

cards.title: Earn Meme Coins
cards.content: Not only does PEPENODE allow you to multiply your $PEPENODE token holdings, top miners will receive additional bonuses in famous meme coins like Pepe, Fartcoin, and more. Enter the presale to be first in line for the world’s first virtual meme coin mining.

howtobuy.title: HOW TO Buy PEPENODE
howtobuy.desc: Earn Bonuses in Meme Coins — Airdrops For Top Miners in $PEPE and $FARTCOIN

cards.title: Step 1
cards.content: Purchase some cryptocurrency through your favorite exchange. If you don’t yet have a wallet or exchange account, consider using options like  Metamask to get started.

cards.title: Step 2
cards.content: Once your wallet is funded, head to the website and click on either the “Buy” or “Connect Wallet” button. This will begin the process of purchasing and staking.

cards.title: Step 3
cards.content: Decide how much $PEPENODE you want to acquire. You can buy and stake in a single step by choosing the “Buy and Stake” option.

cards.title: step 4 (CARD)
cards.content: If you’re using a credit or debit card, first install a mobile crypto wallet or a browser wallet extension. Then connect your wallet to the $PEPENODE site and select the “Card Payment” method to proceed.
